criteria.title: AC2: Formal Judge history exclusion
criteria.explanation: Formal Judge compact input excludes prior review history from documents, patch material, and repository view while retaining permitted production source and current Verification evidence. The implementation classifies feature journals/reports as excluded history, rejects aliases/symlinks/cross-boundary renames, strips excluded paths from inventory and patches, and keeps the exclusion audit outside the Judge view.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:37-55 classifies journal, review, advisory, runtime, and evidence paths as review history.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:75-100 rejects excluded-history aliases and symlinks; lines 191-196 reject cross-boundary renames rather than hiding production paths.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:261-265 applies excluded paths to generated patch material; lines 288-306 build the filtered source view identity.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/agent-workflow-service.js:232 sends only boundary scope when compact review audit exists; lines 313-319 materialize a filtered snapshot and pass the audit only to validation.

evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:233-245 requires spec.md and design.md from the canonical feature home, requires approved design status, and extracts approved rubric IDs from spec.md.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:246-254 rejects missing/duplicate/unknown rubric IDs and disallows partial whole-feature rubric scope.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:288-306 computes inputIdentity, sourceTree, and filteredTreeDigest for the filtered source view.

plugin-src/shared/resources/agent-workflows/judge/validator.js:81-94 requires the compact review audit to match input.change.reviewView, records criteria and reviewView in the manifest, and binds judge-view-audit.json after review.
docs/WORKFLOW-MODULES.md:296-307 states approved spec/design are supplied, journals are not summarized into requirements, and the audit is published outside the Judge repository view.
cli/test/judge-validator.test.js:85-105 verifies the compact audit is bound outside reviewer input and rejects changed provenance or rubric-scope mismatch.

criteria.title: AC6: Large bounded review construction
criteria.explanation: The compact review input streams large Git material to digest-bound chunk files instead of placing aggregate patch payloads in a single JSON field, and the required generated 905-file/24 MiB integration fixture is covered by Verification.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:110-125 streams Git output directly to disk; lines 132-165 split patch material into 64 KiB chunk references with materialHash/materialBytes.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:257-272 builds feature and slice patch files through spooling and deduplicates identical payloads.

cli/test/compact-review.test.js:167-194 constructs a FEATURE fixture with at least 905 changed files and at least 24 MiB of patch material, checks manifest size below 64 KiB, verifies chunk count and chunk sizes, and inspects retained source files.

.gatereeve-agent-evidence/gates/verification/verification.md reports PASS for 291 CLI tests including 905 changed files and at least 24 MiB, and states bounded preparation of GateReeve’s own pinned tree succeeds.

criteria.title: AC6: Patch deduplication and rename representation
criteria.explanation: Identical feature/slice patch content shares a retained payload, while renames are represented with old/new paths and substantive edits rather than duplicate delete/add bodies.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:168-202 uses git diff --raw/--numstat with --find-renames to retain status, oldPath, newPath, oldOid, newOid, and binary classification.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:268-272 compares feature and slice material hash/bytes and reuses the feature patch reference when identical.

cli/test/compact-review.test.js:131-164 verifies rename status, old path, rename-from patch text, substantive edit text, no inline GIT binary patch, shared slicePatch path, and duplicatePatchBytesAvoided.
The supplied compact manifest shows slicePatchSameAsFeature=true and both patch and slicePatch point to .gatereeve-agent-evidence/patches/feature.json.

criteria.title: AC6: Binary before/after evidence access
criteria.explanation: Binary changes retain path/status/OID inventory plus digest-bound old/new content references, and actual bytes are materialized into the immutable snapshot without inline encoded binary payloads in review text.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:273-287 writes binary old/new blobs to .gatereeve-agent-evidence/blobs/<oid>, records hash/bytes references, and attaches oldContent/newContent only for binary inventory entries.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/pinned-snapshot.js:80-118 materializes bound evidence files, copies referenced byte content, and rechecks hash and byte count before exposing the snapshot.

cli/test/compact-review.test.js:131-164 covers binary modify/create/delete, verifies accessible old/new bytes and digest identity, and asserts the patch text does not contain inline GIT binary patch payloads.

apps/desktop/resources/plugins/agentic-development-workflow/resources/agent-workflows/judge/compact-agent.md instructs the Judge to read inventory for binary content references and states binary entries identify old and new content.

criteria.title: AC6: Whole-feature scope and shared-code preservation
criteria.explanation: Whole-feature compact input preserves the selected base/head range, complete source inventory, full assembled snapshot, and final-slice focus without using size-driven omission of shared or unrelated integrated production changes.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/agent-workflow-service.js:16-33 selects FEATURE evaluation from featureBaseSha to headSha and requires a final slice base for FEATURE scope.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/review-input.js:249-254 requires full rubric criteria for FEATURE scope, preventing a feature review from being narrowed to a slice-only subset.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/pinned-snapshot.js:172-198 archives the exact head tree with attributes neutralized, removes only excluded history paths, validates expected source entries, and then materializes evidence.

cli/test/compact-review.test.js:167-194 verifies mixed-feature scope: feature changedFiles include package.json and app.txt, sliceChangedFiles is only app.txt, source.baseSha remains feature base, and assembled snapshot retains app.txt, package.json, and source-0.txt.
